title: One Person or Two?
goal: Choose between an infinitive and que + subjunctive by asking who does the second action.

items: I can choose between an infinitive and que + subjunctive by asking who does the second action.
I can say what I want or feel about my own actions and about someone else's.
I can use the new words for intending and refusing.
